Hi Daniel — thanks, and great to meet (virtually). Below is the quick baseline you asked for. These are our standard Hosted API published list rates (no committed discount):

Per-1M token rates (USD) — Hosted API (list):
- Small family (redwood-mini, ~1–3B): Input $8.00 / 1M tokens, Output $12.00 / 1M tokens
- Medium family (redwood-medium, ~7–13B): Input $14.00 / 1M tokens, Output $28.00 / 1M tokens
- Large family (redwood-large / community 70B): Input $40.00 / 1M tokens, Output $95.00 / 1M tokens
- Producer/LLM-grade (redwood-pro, tuned/optimized): Input $90.00 / 1M tokens, Output $250.00 / 1M tokens

Notes:
- IO split: we bill input and output independently; embeddings are billed as input tokens. The examples above are for text generation and embeddings where applicable.
- Model availability: the following models are generally available on Hosted self-serve (no enterprise-only approval): redwood-mini, redwood-medium, redwood-large (community checkpoints), and our curated embeddings models (redwood-embed-1).
- Models that typically require Dedicated or a commercial agreement: redwood-pro (largest tuned variants), on-prem specialized quantized builds, and any custom fine-tuned customer weights.
- Latency/SLAs: hosted has best-effort latency published on the console. For guaranteed SLOs (p99 latency, dedicated throughput) we recommend Dedicated capacity with an SLA addendum.
- Pilot discounts: for commercial pilots (<=1–2M tokens over 30 days) we commonly offer a one-time 50% credit applied to the first 1M tokens consumed on Hosted to get started (approval required).

Attachments and links: I’ve attached the same ratecard PDF for reference and added a short internal note that summarizes pilot options. Also here’s the public ratecard link: https://app.redwood.ai/docs/hosted-ratecard-v2

If that looks reasonable, Marissa can send a formal pilot offer (PO template + 50% credit clause). I’m also happy to join a 20m call Tuesday to confirm expected token mix and spin up a short test account.

-Rishi
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
